name: Telekom Malaysia Berhad
overview: 2026年，TM 通过其子公司 TM Technology Services 向 Maxis Broadband 授予 2G/4G 国内漫游及 4G MOCN 服务合约，以扩大全国移动覆盖；同时与 Maxis Broadband 的经常性关联交易金额超过 1% 门槛。此外，公司宣派了 2026 财年第一、第二及第三次中期股息。
overview_en: In 2026, TM, through its subsidiary TM Technology Services, awarded a contract to Maxis Broadband for 2G/4G domestic roaming and 4G MOCN services to extend nationwide mobile coverage; recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband also exceeded the 1% threshold. In addition, the company declared its first, second and third interim dividends for FY2026.

segments.name: 综合宽带、移动及数据服务
segments.name_en: Integrated broadband, mobile and data services
segments.note: 今年通过向 Maxis Broadband 授予 2G/4G 国内漫游及 4G MOCN 服务合约，扩大全国移动覆盖。
segments.note_en: This year, expanded nationwide mobile coverage by awarding a contract to Maxis Broadband for 2G/4G domestic roaming and 4G MOCN services.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: TM Technology Services 向 Maxis Broadband 授予 2G 和 4G 国内漫游及 4G MOCN 服务合约，服务期至 2029 年 9 月 30 日，以扩大全国移动覆盖。
actions.text_en: TM Technology Services awarded Maxis Broadband a contract for 2G and 4G domestic roaming and 4G MOCN services until 30 September 2029 to extend nationwide mobile coverage.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年与 Maxis Broadband 的经常性关联交易金额超过 1% 门槛，并宣派 2026 财年三次中期股息。
segments.note_en: This year, recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband exceeded the 1% threshold, and three interim dividends for FY2026 were declared.

actions.title: TM - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派 2026 财年第三次中期单层股息每股 RM0.10。
actions.text_en: Declared third interim single-tier dividend of RM0.10 per share for FY2026.

actions.title: TM - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派 2026 财年第二次中期单层股息每股 RM0.07。
actions.text_en: Declared second interim single-tier dividend of RM0.07 per share for FY2026.

actions.title: TM - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派 2026 财年第一次中期单层股息每股 RM0.065。
actions.text_en: Declared first interim single-tier dividend of RM0.065 per share for FY2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: TM 集团与 Maxis Broadband 的经常性关联交易金额进一步超过 1% 门槛。
actions.text_en: TM Group's recurrent related party transactions with Maxis Broadband further exceeded the 1% threshold.
